title: Custom eggless cakes for Schofields, Marsden Park and Riverstone families
summary:
Searching for a custom eggless cake near Schofields and the closest bakery only does eggless "on request"?

Riverstone has been 100% eggless since it opened in December 2024 — every cake, every flavour, no exceptions. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, and any design you bring in as a photo reference. Buttercream, fondant or ganache, built fresh, not pulled from a freezer.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes, not a delay.

Free parking at Riverstone Shopping Centre, five minutes from Marsden Park or Schofields station. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
